supersedes.immutability: The r6 receipt remains unchanged historical evidence and is not executable authority.
corrections: Use the source-defined canonical receiver root route instead of treating /telemetry as a named route.
Reserve the transaction ID during preparation and seal binding.json before zero-event/event review rather than after event authorization.
Use an executable supported same-owner read-only ledger observer whose first live failure closes the gate; the earlier SQLite error 14 is not treated as resolved.
Require exactly one intended VehicleName projection while observing and classifying every lifecycle and telemetry sequence; one datum is not assumed to equal one sequence.

authority.owner_scope: Debian ARM64 and Apple-silicon macOS only; Viewer and x86 remain excluded.
authority.coordinator_direction: Corrected fresh source staging and certificate/profile preparation may proceed after independent review. Once corrected bindings and certificate checks independently pass, one fresh zero-event run on the existing macOS 13 ARM64 guest is authorized without another preparation loop.
authority.current_actions_performed: Proposal, source review, focused offline tests and reservation checks only.
authority.event_decision: A later explicit coordinator decision is mandatory after both owners review the concrete zero baseline and byte-exact sealed binding.

accepted_actor_binding.preflight_contract: Every input and output is absolute, canonical, owner-only, single-link and non-symlink. All output paths are pairwise distinct, disjoint from inputs and absent before the single clock read. Exclusive creation and atomic final-result publication are mandatory; there is no retry or replay.

ledger_observer.focused_result: PASS 2/2 on a three-sequence synthetic fixture without changing its database or creating a sidecar

certificate_profile_preparation.null_reason: No certificate or profile bytes have been created; the future receipt hash cannot truthfully exist yet.

fresh_cohort_reservation.target: existing macOS 13.7.4 arm64 guest on Apple-silicon host
fresh_cohort_reservation.guest_root_state: reserved only; prove absent before future creation

reserved_ports.edge_hub_facing_address_assignment: Resolve the actual fresh guest-host interface before certificate issuance and runtime start.
reserved_ports.future_rule: Resolve the fresh guest-host interface and recheck all interfaces for every port before staging and again before start. Any occupant rejects r7 without substitution.

identity_and_event_binding.hub_installation_id: Generate once in the fresh r7 Hub root and seal its public hash.
identity_and_event_binding.edge_installation_id: Generate once in the fresh r7 Edge state and seal its public hash.
identity_and_event_binding.edge_lineage: Generate once for the fresh r7 delivery lineage and seal its public hash.
identity_and_event_binding.source_id: Generate once for the fresh synthetic vehicle source and seal its public hash.
identity_and_event_binding.vehicle_identity: Generate a new valid 17-character synthetic VIN during authorized profile preparation, bind the client leaf CommonName to it, and never disclose the raw value in public receipts.
identity_and_event_binding.binding_creation: Create binding.json mode 0600 during profile preparation before zero-event runtime review. It contains event_authorized=false and the exact private vehicle identity, transaction ID, endpoint, canonical payload and accepted helper hash.
identity_and_event_binding.binding_review: Publish only binding path/mode/SHA-256 and redacted identity hash. Edge and Hub must review the exact binding hash before any event decision.
identity_and_event_binding.timestamp: Remain unset until the accepted guard reads CLOCK_REALTIME exactly once after complete event preflight and exclusive authorization validation.

source_staging_gate.authority: Authorized preparation only after independent acceptance of this corrected proposal; it is not runtime or event authority.
requirements: Acquire the shared heavy-build lock with an owner-only record before any build or staging and release it before PKI expiry clocks, guest start or runtime.
Build or copy Edge, receiver, Hub and seed into the fresh r7 staging root from independently revalidated current source/candidate inputs; no closed runtime root is a source.
Stage and rehash the accepted r5 helper and guard plus the reviewed ledger observer under the exact r7 paths with owner-only executable modes.
Publish a redacted manifest with exact hashes, sizes, modes, source revisions and receipt paths. Never publish secret bytes or private-key hashes.
Require the r7 host and guest roots to be canonical, owner-only, single-link/non-symlink where applicable, and fresh.
required_receipts: Accepted r5 helper/guard plus r1 ledger-observer staging receipt

requirements: Generate wholly fresh vehicle-client, receiver-server and Edge-to-Hub trust/auth material inside r7 only; no prior CA, identity, bearer, key or credential may be reused.
Verify exact purposes, issuer, constraints, key usage, EKU, validity, key correspondence and required IP SANs against the staged bytes.
Bind the receiver server leaf to IP SAN 127.0.0.1 for wss://127.0.0.1:21450/ and the Edge server leaf to the resolved fresh guest-host interface.
Create and hash the private event_authorized=false binding before zero-event review while keeping authorization.json, contract.json and all event outputs absent.
Publish the actual redacted certificate/profile receipt with public certificate/CA hashes and private path metadata. Both owners must independently accept it.
certificate_and_profile_gate.failure_policy: Any certificate, ownership, path, identity, endpoint, selector or hash mismatch closes r7 before runtime without repair or substitution.

conditional_zero_event_runtime.authorization: Already conditionally granted by the coordinator once this corrected proposal, source staging, exact profile/binding receipt and certificate checks independently pass; do not add another approval loop.
start_order: Use the existing macOS 13 ARM64 guest and prove the reserved guest root absent before owner-only creation.
Independently rehash all staged public runtime inputs and verify private path metadata without exposing values.
Start the receiver on 127.0.0.1:21450 data and 127.0.0.1:21451 status using the exact fresh TLS profile.
Start Edge on 127.0.0.1:8083 and the resolved guest-host interface port 21846 with a fresh empty encrypted spool.
Start Hub on 127.0.0.1:18531 with a fresh data root and exact Edge trust/auth binding.
Record each launcher/direct-child PID, PPID, UID, argv, listener, binary hash and start time.
conditional_zero_event_runtime.actor_state: binding.json must exist at the independently reviewed hash with event_authorized=false. authorization.json, contract.json, guard.json, result.json, .result.json.tmp and helper-output.log must remain absent. The helper and guard source may be staged but must not be invoked.
required_baseline: Two independently timestamped snapshots at least five seconds apart show exact process/listener ownership and health.
Receiver status is HTTP 200 with body ok and zero admitted, rejected and duplicate messages.
Edge init, doctor, health and readiness pass with empty spool and zero corrupt, expired, gap, admission, duplicate and rejection metrics.
Authenticated Hub delivery pull is HTTP 200 with records=[] and gaps=[] using normal TLS verification.
Hub health, readiness, status and doctor pass with exactly the sealed synthetic vehicle and zero raw/current observations, pending publications zero, ACK frontier null and latest observation ID zero.

The exact staged ledger observer runs as the Hub database owner against the canonical owner-only database and reports zero selected lineage, applications, sequences, non-complete publications and accumulator rows. Any open, ownership, schema or query error fails the baseline and is never converted to zero.
The shared build lock is absent; binding is unchanged; event authorization/contract/output files remain absent.
conditional_zero_event_runtime.review: Hub and Edge independently review exact runtime, profile, binding and zero-state receipts before the coordinator is asked for the separate submit-once event decision.

submit_once_event_gate.event: Exactly one synthetic VehicleName V datum through the accepted helper and guard; no retry, replay, duplicate or second timestamp.
preconditions: Both owners accepted the exact stable zero baseline and the byte-exact event_authorized=false binding.
Runtime identities, selectors, TLS material, processes and listeners still match the accepted receipts and remain within expiry.
authorization.json, contract.json and every guard/result/temp/output path remain absent and pairwise disjoint.
Coordinator explicitly authorizes the one event against the exact cohort, binding hash and transaction ID.
sealing_after_authorization: Write authorization.json mode 0600 with event_authorized=true, invocation_count=1, retry_or_replay=false, exact binding/helper/payload/TLS hashes, bounded timeout and short expiry.
Write contract.json mode 0600 embedding the byte-exact authorization and exact path/hash/mode references.
Independently rehash binding, authorization, contract, helper, guard and TLS public inputs; verify every output remains absent.

Invoke the accepted guard exactly once with the reserved absolute paths. The guard reads one clock, exclusively creates its records/output, spawns the helper once and atomically publishes one final result.

post_event_observation.projection_contract: Exactly one intended projected_telemetry application and exactly one public VehicleName projection must bind the fixed transaction/payload. This does not predict the total number of durable applications or sequences.
post_event_observation.sequence_contract: Observe every application and every sequence ordered by spool_seq. Classify every additional lifecycle sequence by its actual category and reason; require no unexplained, rejected, duplicate or gapped row. A one-datum-equals-one-sequence assertion is prohibited.
required_evidence: The guard and final result show one completed helper child with exit 0 and exact transaction, payload, helper and public certificate hashes; no temporary result remains.
Helper output has the accepted identity marker and one matching binary receiver ACK without any private key or bearer value.
Receiver reports one admitted submitted message for the sealed identity and no duplicate or rejection increment.
Edge spool/frontier evidence and the supported Hub observer together account for every actual lifecycle and telemetry sequence, with pending/spool zero only after durable Hub handling.

The observer records exactly one projected_telemetry application for VehicleName, classifies every extra sequence/application, records no non-complete publication, and binds the actual frontier and accumulator state.
Hub durable commit precedes Edge ACK/frontier advancement using durable identifiers rather than timestamp-only inference.
A following authenticated pull returns records=[] and gaps=[]; no second producer invocation exists and all counts remain stable for a final five-second observation.
post_event_observation.acceptance_rule: All exact actor, admission, durability, classification, projection, ACK/frontier and cleanup assertions must pass. A receiver ACK, log, health response, source test, fixture or candidate build alone is not forwarding acceptance.

failure_policy: Before guard claim, any mismatch closes r7 without an event and without path substitution.
After guard claim, timeout, child failure, invalid ACK, ledger mismatch or observation failure consumes the sole event attempt; no retry, replay or live repair is permitted.
Preserve only owner-only redacted failure evidence and never relabel partial evidence as acceptance.
failure_and_cleanup.cleanup_owner: Hub owns the bounded shared runtime and exact r7 cleanup. Edge owns independent review only. Installed Hub 8443, HA 18483, historical cohorts, unrelated processes and keychain entries remain untouched.
ordered_cleanup: Stop only the exact Hub launcher/direct child and record its exit.
Stop only the exact receiver PID after no producer child remains and record its exit.
Stop only the exact Edge PID after final spool/frontier evidence and record its exit.
Remove one-use authorization, bearer, credential and private-key files after redacted bindings are sealed; retain no reusable secret copy.
Verify ports 18531, 21450, 21451, 21846 and 8083 closed, every recorded PID absent, the guest stopped and the shared build lock absent.
Retain only versioned owner-only evidence roots and redacted receipts as closed non-reusable evidence.

proof_boundary: This is a corrected inactive source/profile/runtime/event proposal plus source and synthetic-fixture proof. No r7 staging, PKI, identity, credential, guest, listener, zero baseline, event, forwarding, service, release, production, vehicle or user acceptance has occurred.
